title: Case split on the attainable sunny-line counts {0,1,3} for IMO 2025 P1
intent: Reduce the statement 'the attainable sunny-line counts are exactly {0,1,3}' to three constructions and two impossibilities. The forward direction of the set equality enumerates the finite answer set {0,1,3} and closes each member with a construction lemma (k = 0, 1, 3); the backward direction bounds k ≤ 3 with an impossibility lemma, then interval_cases k and rules out k = 2 with a second impossibility lemma.

parent.name: main_theorem
parent.statement:
theorem main_theorem
  (n : ℕ)
  (hn : n ≥ 3) :
  {0, 1, 3} = { k | ∃ lines : Finset (Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
      (∀ line ∈ lines, ∃ a b c, ¬ (a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧ line = { v : ℝ × ℝ | a * v.1 + b * v.2 + c = 0 }) ∧
      lines.card = n ∧
      (∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ a + b ≤ n + 1 → ∃ (l : Set (ℝ × ℝ)), l ∈ lines ∧ ((a : ℝ), (b : ℝ)) ∈ l) ∧
      ((lines.filter (fun l => ∃ a b c, l = { v : ℝ × ℝ | a * v.1 + b * v.2 + c = 0 } ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ b)).card = k) }

lemma lem_k0_possible (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 3) :
  ∃ lines : Finset (Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
    (∀ line ∈ lines, ∃ a b c, ¬ (a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧ line = { v | a * v.1 + b * v.2 + c = 0 }) ∧
    lines.card = n ∧
    (∀ p ∈ s n, ∃ l ∈ lines, p ∈ l) ∧
    (lines.filter Sunny).card = 0
children.closed_by: obtain ⟨lines, hlines⟩ := lem_k0_construction n hn; use (Finset.image ...); aesop (lines 128-137)

applicability.goal_shape: a set equality {v1, ..., vm} = { k | P k } where the left side is a literal finite set of naturals ('exactly these values are attainable'); the forward direction enumerates the left set, the backward direction bounds k by an impossibility lemma and then interval_cases k
applicability.use_when: the answer is a small finite set of values; each attainable value already has a construction lemma and each excluded value an impossibility lemma; the excluded values are bounded by one lemma so interval_cases terminates; the construction lemmas share one statement shape so `convert` + `unfold` closes each case uniformly
applicability.avoid_when: the answer set is large or unknown; the constructions and impossibilities are not already isolated as named lemmas (then the glue is not the content); the excluded cases need deep reasoning that cannot be compressed into a single bounding lemma and a small interval_cases

consequences: Forward: `cases' hk with hk0 hk1 hk3` on the finite set {0,1,3} creates one goal per element and leaves the exhaustiveness of that enumeration to Lean (the disjunction over the finset). Each goal is closed by `convert` to a construction lemma whose statement matches up to unfolding, repaired by `unfold s`/`unfold Sunny`/`aesop`. Backward: the split on k is indirect — the glue first proves k ≤ 3 by contraposing lem_k_ge_4_impossible, then `interval_cases k` yields 0,1,2,3, and the one excluded case k=2 is disposed of by lem_k2_impossible. Failure mode: `convert` needs the goal and child to be definitionally close; if a child's statement diverges from the parent's inline predicates, each case needs its own normalisation and the shared `convert … <;> unfold …` pattern breaks.
